keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria starts the Barghawata in 793 but the page gives 'Established: 744' ('established an independent state (AD 744-1058) in the area of Tamesna'; the Berber Revolt page: the Barghawata state in Tamesna 'by 744'). The 793 outline is reused; no page gives a boundary for 744-792.

36,301 km2 on the Atlantic coast of Tamesna (31.2-33.4 N, 9.8-7.4 W). The page puts the state 'on the Atlantic coast between Safi and Salé'; the Tamasna page 'between Bou Regreg and Tensift' (Chaouia, Doukkala-Abda, Rhamna, Sraghna, Chiadma); no infobox area. The Idrisid page: in 828 the Barghawata 'remained outside their control'. Cliopatria stops short of Salé (34.0 N).

36,581 km2, the same core once the neighbours change. The page has the 11th-century guerrilla war with the Banu Ifran (undated) and the false claim of annihilation in 1029 (al-Bakri), but no change of land.

correction.text: the Tamesna core only; the 1040 shape's northern exclave near the Strait (35.6-35.8 N, 5.8-5.3 W, about 1,500 km2) is dropped

keyframe_review.note: 38,057 km2: the 1015 core plus a six-cell exclave 400 km to the north near Tangier and Ceuta. Nothing on the Barghawata, Tamasna or Almoravid pages puts the Barghawata near the Strait, and the page's 'expansion' of the 1040s is not mentioned there, so the exclave is cut (unverified either way).

correction.text: the Tamesna core only, valid to 1060

keyframe_review.note: Same outline as 1040 and the same exclave. Years: the Almoravids reach the Barghawata in 1058, Abdallah ibn Yasin dies fighting them in 1058 or 1059, and 'by 1060, Abu Bakr ibn Umar had conquered them'; Cliopatria runs to 1065, the infobox to 1058.

region.text: Tamesna, 'on the Atlantic coast between Safi and Salé'

ledger.note: 744: Salih ibn Tarif founds the Barghawata state in Tamesna. 'Established an independent state (AD 744-1058) in the area of Tamesna'; the Barghawata left the Berber Revolt in 742 or 743 and 'retreated to Tamesna' (the page marks this '[citation needed]'); Salih 'declared himself prophet in 744'.

region.text: Tamesna, entered by the Almoravids after they took Aghmat

ledger.note: 1058: the Almoravids reach the Barghawata. 'In 1058, the Almoravids crossed the High Atlas and took Aghmat, then came into contact with the Barghawata'; Abdallah ibn Yasin 'was killed fighting them in 1058 or 1059' (7 July 1058 on the Barghawata page).
By 1060 the fighting is over: 'By 1060, Abu Bakr ibn Umar had conquered them and forced them to convert to orthodox Islam.' The page's 'by' makes 1060 a latest date.

1060: Tamesna falls to the Almoravids. The Tamasna page adds that the Barghawata were 'driven out by the Almoravids, who installed Bedouin Arabs'. The infobox says 'Disestablished: 1058' (the year Ibn Yasin died fighting them).

region.text: the Barghawata state's last land, Tamesna

ledger.note: 1060: the Barghawata state ends under Almoravid rule. Remnants lasted: the Almohads in 1149 'eliminated the Barghawata as a political and religious group' (Barghawata page); Cliopatria ends it in 1065.

wars.name: Umayyad incursions into Tamesna
wars.outcome: Relations with the Umayyads of Cordoba were 'initially good', then broke 'at the end of the 10th century'; two Umayyad incursions were repelled.
wars.note: The page gives no years; 990-1000 is the page's 'end of the 10th century'. Fatimid attacks were also 'fought off', undated.

wars.name: Almoravid conquest of the Barghawata
wars.outcome: The Almoravids, after Aghmat (1058), meet the Barghawata; Abdallah ibn Yasin dies fighting them (1058 or 1059); Abu Bakr ibn Umar conquers them by 1060 and forces their conversion.
wars.note: The Barghawata page dates Ibn Yasin's fall to 7 July 1058 and the state's disestablishment to 1058.

certainty.note: A tribal confederacy with no frontier named on any page opened; the outline is approximate between Safi, Salé and the Tensift.

notes: Cliopatria's Wikipedia field for this row is 'Casablanca' and its Wikidata id Q7903 is Casablanca's: a mismatch, so identity.wikipedia is the state article 'Barghawata' and wikidata is null (the Barghawata item is not known to me from a page and Wikidata is unreachable); the compiler should seed the row as Barghawata. Dates: Cliopatria 793-1065; the page 744-1058 (infobox) with the Almohad elimination in 1149; the dossier takes 744 and 1060 ('by 1060 ... conquered', Almoravid page), because the infobox's 1058 is the year the Almoravid leader died fighting them. The 1040 and 1056 shapes carry a six-cell exclave near the Strait that no page supports; the 1040s expansion is a Cliopatria artefact until a page says otherwise. Capitals: no page opened (Barghawata, Tamasna) names a capital, so identity.capitals is empty rather than invented; Casablanca (Anfa) is only Cliopatria's pointer. The Banu Ifran guerrilla war of the 11th century, the Umayyad incursions and the Fatimid attacks are undated on the page. Gazetteer: no 'Tamesna' region; the core is named through Cliopatria; 'Tamesna' (region between Bou Regreg and Tensift) is a name the gazetteer lacks.
